scope: Current evidence for KUSTO usefulness on real bathymetry / acoustic-backscatter / cross-survey marine data. This ledger separates formal validation, robustness support, case-level recovery, and blocked tests.

nonpromotion_evidence.finding: Bathymetry candidates retained backscatter enrichment after excluding a zero-MAD metric, but the correction was posthoc and cannot validate the method.
Cross-channel enrichment transferred without the zero-MAD pathology, but a frozen tile-radius stratum lacked scoreable backscatter coverage, so the preregistered primary test was blocked.

Blind bathymetry candidates were frozen, but backscatter controls were degenerate because native nodata metadata did not define a usable acquisition support domain. This failure motivated paired-support-domain v2; Cross Sound is calibration-only for that change.

The blind detector recovered the ROV-confirmed natural rock feature in EX1903L2 within about 18 m, but missed it under frozen selection in EX1203 and EX1805 despite local soundings; no cross-survey recovery was established.
ScienceBase did not support byte-range acquisition for 0.6-0.8 GB archives; no numeric detector result was taken.

With the official dive-site anchor withheld until after candidate freeze, blind rank-1 landed 5.375 m from the independent anchor. Because the survey was acquired specifically around the wreck and all 10 candidates were within 200 m, this remains case-level recovery only.

Direct WFS source_references queries returned 0/8 local source-reference hits. This does not imply no bathymetric data exists; it only blocks using current EMODnet source_references as independent lineage for these frozen Atlantic points.

Independent IMAS/UWA BRUV/drop-camera annotations provided 727 georeferenced rows (722 unique coordinates). Under the preregistered frozen-radius rule: 0/100 direct image-record intersections, 62 near within 1 km, 37 regional within 1-5 km, and 1 with no image record within 5 km. All six SWC2 acoustic-supported candidates had only NEAR_IMAGE_COVERAGE; none had direct visual support.

The public mac-swc repository contains AUV analysis/model references but no recovered exact Nimbus/USBL navigation track in tree/code search. Report figures or predictions are not substituted for a real georeferenced track.

100/100 frozen candidates were scorable and 40/100 exceeded same-radius q95, but the preregistered population criterion failed: candidate mean 29.5827 vs control mean 942.7372, stratified permutation p=0.198760. Posthoc diagnosis identified near-zero-but-nonzero MAD in the 160 m edge-energy control metric as the heavy-tail mechanism. The formal FAIL is immutable. Subsequent withheld-truth characterization found actual towed-video observation points inside only 3/100 frozen candidate disks and sediment samples inside 0/100; this does not promote or reinterpret the FAIL.

utility_now_supported: KUSTO has six formal unseen cross-channel enrichment PASSes on real datasets.

Five formal unseen marine paired-support-domain v2 PASSes are preserved across Maui/Puunoa, Shellharbour/Tharawal, South-west Corner, Elizabeth/Middleton and Arafura/Money Shoal, spanning multiple geographic, sensor, grid-resolution and representation lineages.
The same frozen v2 retains one immutable formal unseen marine FAIL on Solitary Islands, demonstrating that the method is not being promoted by always-pass selection.

Arafura additionally shows that the method can survive a preregistered representation bridge from geographic 6 m bathymetry to projected 2 m held-out backscatter without resampling the discovery raster.
KUSTO remains an evidence-ranked anomaly-prioritization layer; object identity, artificiality, global precision/recall and general independent-survey repeatability remain unestablished.
next_required_expansion: Shift the next unchanged-v2 corpus outside Australia/US lineages, prioritizing a source-resolved European or North Atlantic paired bathymetry/backscatter survey.
Advance the >=20 high-confidence target benchmark from registered candidates to LEVEL_3 blind-evaluated targets.
Keep v3 separate from v2; rescue efficacy for the relative-MAD guard remains unproven despite unseen no-regression on Elizabeth/Middleton.
After Arafura A3, only then bind Money Shoal seabed samples/underwater imagery to frozen candidates under a separate post-result characterization prereg.
